This is `tract-onnx` 0.23.9 from crates.io, retained under its upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses. `src/tensor.rs::resolve_external_data_path` is patched for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`: it preserves relative path-component validation, then returns the relative joined path without filesystem canonicalization so the custom in-memory `ModelDataResolver` can service it. All non-wasm32-unknown targets retain upstream filesystem canonicalization and containment checks. Trailing whitespace in generated `src/prost/onnx.rs` comments was normalized without changing code.
